description: List your workspace's hosted pricing models: models Last Price stores and runs for you, trained here on your quote outcomes or uploaded as ONNX. Each one has its id, name, kind (demand or price), active and latest version, and whether it retrains and promotes itself nightly. The answer also gives the limits, the ONNX operators the hosted runtime runs and the request fields a model can read. A pricing function of the ML model type runs a model when its inference config is {"provider": "last-price", "model": "<model id>"}. While hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace, this answers released: false with no models, and every other hosted model tool answers 404 not_released. Needs a Last Price credential with function read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_hosted_models
